protocol: Same architecture, seed, sampler, AdamW (constant lr 0.001), loss and 284/61/62 subject split. 200 batches x 24 windows per epoch. Nested budgets 12/36/120; each uses minimum validation MSE checkpoint within budget. Test never selects checkpoint or seed. 0.5 s burn-in, equal-subject aggregation. SD across 3 seeds.
limitations: VR eye movements do not establish webcam fingertip accuracy or human-like behavior.
Longer training does not change the monocular depth assumption.
